conventions.event round: Round making the births; parent identities refer to the incoming live roster.
conventions.all live connected by joins: On the incoming live knots, take the transitive closure of sharing a join as parents. A single live knot is connected.
conventions.join has all live parents: A single join names every incoming live knot. Other births may occur in that round.
conventions.sole birth is a join: Exactly one birth, and it has at least two parents.
conventions.birth descends from all live start knots: Take the union of the known start ancestors of each parent at each birth.
conventions.last: Last event through the final saved round. An event there is censored on the right.
